verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Delaware incorporation document generator and a generic guidance hub, but nothing that guides founders on choosing an entity type or jurisdiction such as Delaware C-corp versus UK Ltd, GmbH/UG or Indian Pvt Ltd. Generating Delaware formation documents is an adjacent feature: it does not advise on which structure suits a given market.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes guidance on choosing entity type and jurisdiction of incorporation (Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG, Indian Pvt Ltd) appropriate to my market
